path.description: The file, relative to the project root, POSIX-spelled. For a deletion, the path that was deleted

status.description: What happened to it since the base. A rename or copy crossing the root's boundary is reported as seen from inside the root: renamed or copied in is "added", renamed out is "deleted", copied out is no row. An untracked file is "added"; git pairs only paths the index knows into a rename, so an un-added move reads as deleted + added

oldPath.description: Where a "renamed" or "copied" file came from, relative to the project root; NULL for every other status

similarity.description: git's similarity score (0-100) for a "renamed" or "copied" file; NULL for every other status

projection-changed-files.description: A row of the derived `changed_files` relation
